For a leading manufacturer in the machine building industry in the region, we are looking for a dedicated Senior Electrical Engineer.

In this key engineering role, you will act as the technical owner for the complete electrical hardware design, ensuring every machine meets the highest quality and safety standards!

As Senior Electrical Engineer, you will take full ownership of the electrical engineering lifecycle:

• Concept & Project Planning: Participate in multidisciplinary project design meetings with mechanical and software engineers from the concept phase onwards, creating realistic project schedules and milestones.
• Electrical Design (EPLAN P8 & ProPanel): Translate draft electrical descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed hardware guidelines. Design and adapt electrical schematics in EPLAN P8 and create 3D panel/enclosure layouts in EPLAN ProPanel.
• Standards & Compliance: Ensure all designs strictly comply with European directives and international regulations (e.g., EN 60204, Machinery Directive, EMC, LVD).
• ERP & Production Follow-Up: Create and update ERP work orders for customer-specific projects and master BOMs for standard machinery. Closely monitor electrical assembly during the build phase in the workshop.
• Standardization & Mentorship: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve electrical design guidelines and best practices. Review schematics with colleagues, offer technical guidance, and actively drive departmental standardization initiatives.

• Education & Experience: You hold a Master’s degree in Industrial Sciences (Electromechanics / Electrotechnics) or possess equivalent experience. You have at least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within the machine building sector.
• Software & Standards: Strong proficiency in EPLAN P8 is required (hands-on experience with EPLAN ProPanel is a major plus). Solid working knowledge of European electrical safety standards (familiarity with UL standards for the North American market is an asset).
• Key Strengths: You possess an analytical mindset, excellent problem-solving skills, and a structured way of working.
• Languages & Communication: Excellent communication skills in both English and Dutch, with a collaborative team spirit suited for an international environment.

About the role 

The Finance & HR Officer is responsible for the day-to-day administration of IVAA's human resources and finances. The role ensures the smooth coordination of monthly payroll, employee administration, invoices, payments and financial records. 

Working closely with the Secretary General and the Treasurer, as well as external service providers, the officer maintains accurate and up-to-date administrative and financial information and supports regular financial monitoring and reporting. 

The position requires a highly organised, reliable and discreet individual who can manage several administrative processes independently while working within the organisation's established procedures and approval arrangements. 

Key responsibilities 

Finances 

• Receive, organise and file incoming and outgoing invoices and supporting financial documentation. 
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of income and expenditure in the organisation's financial tracking system or accounting software. 
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and monitor the organisation's cash position. 
• Provide regular financial overviews for the Treasurer and the Secretary General.  
• Support periodic financial reporting and the preparation of documents required by the Treasurer, external accountants or auditors, where applicable. 
• Monitor expenditure against the approved budget and respond to routine financial queries. 
• Issue receipts for payments received, including membership payments and fees, and maintain a corresponding record. 
• Contribute to the selection and set-up of accounting software 
• Coordinate and process payments to employees, contractors, partners and service providers. 
• Process employee and partner reimbursement requests in accordance with the organisation's procedures. 
• Maintain a register of contracts with partners, contractors and service providers, and monitor payment schedules, invoicing and amounts against contract terms. 
HR administration 

• Prepare and submit monthly payroll information for all employees to the external payroll service provider. 
• Coordinate with the provider to ensure payroll inputs are accurate, complete and submitted on time. 
• Coordinate employee-related payroll changes, including starters, leavers, absences and changes to employment conditions. 
• Act as the first point of contact for employees on routine HR and administrative matters, including leave, certificates, employee details and benefits. 
• Maintain complete, accurate and confidential employee files and HR records. 
• Coordinate the administration of employment contracts, leave records and other employment documentation. 
• Coordinate employee admin onboarding and offboarding, ensuring that the necessary documentation, registrations and administrative arrangements are completed. 
External service providers 

• Liaise with service providers and public administrations as required. 
• Administer the relevant online platforms used for invoices, payments and financial documentation. 
• Coordinate contracting processes with service providers, in collaboration with the Secretary General. 
Other tasks 

• Coordinate general office logistics (office cleaning, maintenance, repair services...) 
• Manage office supplies, stationery and equipment. 
• Any other tasks as required 
 

 
 
Skills and qualifications 

• Bachelor's degree (haute école or university) in accounting, finance, HR management, finance, administration or a related field. 
• At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in finance administration and payroll/HR administration (minimum: finance administration and demonstrated exposure to payroll/HR administration). 
• Solid knowledge of bookkeeping, invoice processing, payment administration, reimbursements and budget monitoring. 
• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, and financial reporting. 
• Experience with accounting software, including set-up, is an advantage. 
• Knowledge of Belgian payroll and employment administration (e.g. working with a social secretariat) is an advantage. 
• Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and a systematic approach to record-keeping. 
• High level of discretion and integrity when handling confidential employee, contractual and financial information. 
• Clear, professional and friendly communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with employees, management and external partners. 
• Ability to work independently while recognising when to seek guidance or approval. 
Languages: Working proficiency in English and French is required.

For
 Bier Central in Mechelen and Antwerp, we’re looking for students/flexi's who are passionate about cooking and aren’t afraid of a fast-paced environment.

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Motivated student/flexi's with a passion for cooking. 
Professional experience is a plus, but certainly not a requirement.
  

•  

People who enjoy working hard and are open to learning new things
  

•  

Preferably fluent in English. Other languages are a plus.
  

•  

People who are available during the Christmas holidays. That’s our busiest—but also our most fun—time of the year. Can’t work every day? No problem, but we’d love to see you for a few shifts a week.
